properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.webapps.enabled
properties.description: Whether Cockpit, Tasklist and Admin serve the engine of this adapter id. Switch it off for an engine which only exists for a migration. All keys of this section work for every adapter id of type 'camunda7', not only for the id 'camunda7'.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.webapps.admin-user.id
properties.description: The id of the administrator the start creates. Without an admin user the webapps show their setup wizard.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.webapps.admin-user.password
properties.description: The password of the administrator. It is never logged.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.webapps.admin-user.first-name
properties.description: The first name shown next to the administrator.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.webapps.admin-user.last-name
properties.description: The last name shown next to the administrator.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.camunda7.webapps.admin-user.email
properties.description: The mail address of the administrator.
